title: Original Ballad Phrase 001

context.prompt_summary: Rewrite a simple four-bar C major ballad phrase into richer Real Book-level jazz harmony while preserving the melody.

reference_rationale: Cmaj9 preserves E and G as stable major-family melody tones while adding ballad color.
E7b9 functions as V/vi and supports G/A/B melody motion as altered dominant color leading into Am9.
A7b13 creates a secondary dominant pull into Dm9 without breaking the descending melody contour.
Db7#11 is a tritone substitute for G7, creating chromatic root motion into the final dominant area.
G13sus keeps F as a stable suspended dominant color and avoids forcing an early resolution.

common_failure_modes: Changes every beat with no ballad pacing.
Uses substitutions that clash with structural melody notes.
Treats the final F melody note over G7 as an avoid tone instead of a valid suspended or dominant seventh color.
Adds complex altered dominants without explaining their functional resolution.
Outputs only chord names without any musical rationale.

model_response_requirements.notes: The response should preserve the melody and keep the harmonic rhythm appropriate for a slow jazz ballad.
